title: Final Equation Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the equation v^2 = dp/drho for sound speed.

title: Isothermal Speed Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the speed of sound for the isothermal case as v^2 = RT/m.

title: Adiabatic Speed Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the speed of sound for the adiabatic case as v^2 = gamma RT/m.

title: Comparison of Results
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear comparison of the isothermal and adiabatic results for air.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes in calculations, particularly in the context of pressure and density.
